stored.p1: Own accounts keep a made-up name, a password (stored scrambled) and what your child does here: the games they make, their chats with the Builder and any pictures or files they add, saves, scores, ratings, favourites, friends, chat messages, a profile photo if they upload one, and settings such as language and theme. Guest play keeps a made-up name, saves, scores, ratings and favourites.

board.description: Roll the dice and race along a winding path with rocket boosts and slides. Play a friend or the bot.

selfharm.suggestion: I am here to build a happy game with you whenever you want, like a cosy puppy who collects stars.

scary.suggestion: How about a silly, friendly ghost who collects sweets?

drugs.suggestion: How about a potion lab where you mix bubbly colours?

play.signInToLike: Sign in or play as a guest to save favourites.

favorites.title: My favourites
favorites.emptyText: Tap ❤️ Favourite on any game and it will wait for you here.

settings.timeZoneNone: Not set (days are counted in UTC)
settings.timeZoneUnset: Set your school's time zone so lessons open at midnight and due dates end at midnight where you are. Until then, nobody is late until 36 hours after the due day starts.
settings.timeZoneHint: Lessons open at midnight and due dates end at midnight in this zone. It's {time} there now.

errors.badZone: Pick a time zone from the list.

step.newGamePlaceholder: e.g. a quiz with 10 questions about fractions for Year 4

assign.zoneNote: {zone, select, none {Days are counted in UTC and nobody is late until 36 hours after the due day starts. A school admin can set the school's time zone in Settings.} other {Lessons open and due dates end at midnight in {zone}.}}

price.p1: {monthly} a month or {yearly} a year, plus sales tax where it applies. Cancel any time: the plan runs to the end of the period you paid for.

cancel.a: Yes, any time. The plan runs to the end of the period you paid for, then your children go back to the free messages. Nothing they made is deleted.

terms.cancel: Cancel any time in Manage billing. The plan keeps working until the end of the period you paid for.
